title: Light, place and quiet moments
text:
Between the frames · Beyond the moment
    Light, place and quiet moments

    Good to know
    About the prints
  
  
    
      Are the prints limited editions?
      
        Both are available. Each limited edition is restricted to 3 to 5 prints of a photograph. Limited-edition prints are signed and numbered, come with a certificate of authenticity, and are shipped by me. Open-edition prints are also available.
      
    
    
      What sizes are available?
      
        Most photographs are offered in 60 × 80 cm or 60 × 90 cm sizes. Open-edition prints on Photo4me come in various other formats.
      
    
    
      What paper and materials are used?
      
        Prints are made on museum-grade, 350 g/m² fine art paper or on 400 g/m² linen canvas for exceptional quality and longevity.
      
    
    
      Where can I buy a print?
      
        
          Saatchi Art: limited-edition originals shipped by me, and open-edition prints printed and shipped by Saatchi Art.
          Artfinder: limited editions shipped by me.
          Photo4me: open-edition prints in various formats, printed and shipped by Photo4me.
        
      
    
    
      Which gallery should I choose?
      
        Prices and shipping options vary across galleries, so compare them for the print you want and choose the one that suits you. For a signed, numbered limited edition, look at Saatchi Art or Artfinder; for an open-edition print, look at Saatchi Art or Photo4me.
      
    
    
      Can I buy a print directly from you?
      
        Yes, for limited-edition prints only. Send an enquiry through the contact page. Where import and export rules allow, I can ship the print to you directly. Direct sales are final and non-returnable, and orders are shipped once full payment has been received.
      
    
    
      How can I check that a print is genuine?
      
        Every limited-edition print comes with a certificate of authenticity. Scan its QR code, or enter the certificate number on the Verify a certificate page.

title: Praveen Kumar Singh
text:
№ — the one behind the lens
    

    
      About
      Praveen Kumar Singh
      Photographer & Atmospheric Science Researcher
      
      Based in — Paris

      
      
        By profession, I am an atmospheric scientist who studies the air, the weather, and how they shape the places we live in. Photography grew out of the same curiosity. I am drawn to the moments when the atmosphere changes a place, such as mist over a field at dusk, rain on a city pavement, or the blue hour when a monument lights up before the sky has gone dark.
      
      
        Most of these photographs were made patiently, on foot, and in available light, in Paris, where I live, and on journeys through India and Nepal. Whether the subject is a monument, a passer-by, or a butterfly, I am looking for the same thing: the instant when light, weather, and life line up.
      
      
        Selected photographs are available as signed, limited-edition prints with a certificate of authenticity. I also take on commissions and license images for editorial and commercial use. Get in touch to talk about a print, an idea, or a collaboration.

title: Privacy & cookies
text:
Your data
    Privacy & cookies
    This is a personal photography portfolio. It collects as little as possible, and nothing is sold or shared for advertising.
  

  Who runs this website
  Praveen Kumar Singh, Paris, France. Contact: praveen.singh@writtenwithlight.com.

  Cookies and visitor statistics
  The site uses Google Analytics to count visits and see which pages are read, so it can be improved. Google Analytics only runs after you click Accept in the cookie banner. If you decline, no statistics cookies are set.
  If you accept, Google Analytics sets cookies and records the pages you visit, roughly where you are (country or city), your device and browser, and how you arrived at the site. This information is processed by Google (Google Ireland Limited) and used only for these statistics. You can change your choice at any time with the Cookie preferences link at the bottom of every page.

  Other things the site stores or loads
  
    Light or dark mode: your choice is kept in your own browser. It is never sent anywhere.
    Contact form: your name, email address and message are sent by Formspree to my email, and are used only to reply to you.
    Fonts: the typefaces are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address so it can send them.
    Hosting: the site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may log visitors' IP addresses for security.
  

  Your rights
  You can ask to see, correct or delete any personal information I hold about you by writing to the address above. You can also complain to the French data protection authority, the CNIL.

  Last updated: November 2026
